implementation: HybridStorageService upload/read using PocketDimension hybrid-cold-storage entries and hybrid:storage:index over the local implementation of the production PDIM HTTP exec contract

recoveryGate.behavior: PocketDimension metadata/index and the hybrid ownership index now initialize empty only after authoritative null reads; malformed JSON, invalid shapes, partial records, and PDIM read failures fail explicitly before writes.

gaps: Off-instance transport was simulated with a separate local temporary export directory only; no remote backup service or independent machine was used.
No AppStorage, shared database, production credentials, or actual user data was read, exported, restored, or deleted.
This proves the real HybridStorageService -> PocketDimension -> PDIM key path for synthetic content, not recovery of retained production user PDIM content; that operational recovery remains a gap.
